
Architecture: amd64

  ALLOW:
    read
    write when (count & fd & 0xffff) == (buf | 0x10)
    openat when flags == (0x1337 & filename)

  TRACE(1):
    <default> (any other syscall)

  ERRNO(1):
    write when (count & fd & 0xffff) != (buf | 0x10)
    openat when flags != (0x1337 & filename)

  KILL:
    sys_number >= 0x40000000  (x32 ABI)

Other architectures: KILL
